title: Rethinking and Improving Autoformalization: Towards a Faithful Metric and a Dependency Retrieval-Based Approach
authors_zh: Qi Liu, Xinhao Zheng, Xudong Lu, Qinxiang Cao, Junchi Yan
paper_type_zh: 语义验证与依赖检索的 Lean 自动形式化基准
best_for_zh: 研究 Lean 自动形式化、语义等价验证或定理检索的研究者。
one_line: This work couples a bidirectional Lean equivalence verifier with dependency retrieval and the 961-item Con-NF benchmark to measure and improve faithful autoformalization.
论文以双向 BEq 验证、依赖检索和 961 题 Con-NF，将自动形式化的评测从可编译性推进到可验证的语义等价。
why: It distinguishes semantic correctness from compilability and makes library dependencies explicit supervision for formalization.
inclusion_reason: The released Con-NF and equivalence labels pair Lean statements with executable semantic-verification outcomes and dependency supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html: Autoformalization faces two linked problems: Lean compilation alone cannot determine whether a candidate is semantically equivalent to the natural-language statement, and models hallucinate definitions or theorems when library dependencies are missing. The paper addresses both evaluation and generation by proposing Bidirectional Extended Definitional Equivalence (BEq), which formally checks equivalence between statements, and dependency retrieval with RAutoformalizer, which retrieves relevant formal objects before generation. It also releases the research-level Con-NF parallel benchmark for out-of-distribution evaluation.
自动形式化研究面临两个相互关联的问题：只用 Lean 编译率无法判断候选陈述是否与自然语言语义等价，而模型缺少库依赖上下文时又容易虚构定义和定理。论文同时解决评测与生成：提出双向扩展定义等价 BEq，用形式证明检查两个陈述的等价性；再提出依赖检索任务与 RAutoformalizer，在生成前检索相关形式对象。作者还发布研究级 Con-NF 平行基准，用于检验分布外自动形式化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution combines a verifier, retrieval supervision, and a dataset. BEq attempts bidirectional formal reduction between candidate and reference statements, reducing errors from exact match or one-way implication; it is evaluated on 200 expert-labelled statement pairs. Con-NF contains 961 natural-language–formal theorem pairs involving 1,348 research-level formal objects. A dependency parser creates retrieval training data from library topology, and RAutoformalizer conditions Lean generation on retrieved objects.

核心贡献包括一个 verifier、一类检索监督和一个数据集。BEq 双向尝试把候选与参考陈述归约为可证明等价，减少仅靠 exact match 或单向蕴含产生的误判；作者在 200 对专家标注陈述上评测该指标。Con-NF 含 961 个自然语言—形式定理对，并涉及 1,348 个研究级形式对象。依赖解析器按库拓扑关系生成检索训练数据，RAutoformalizer 用检索结果约束 Lean 输出。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build equivalence labels: Collect 200 diverse Lean statement pairs and obtain expert semantic-equivalence judgments as a metric test set.
  1. Run BEq: Expand definitions in both directions and invoke restricted proof automation; equivalence is accepted when the bidirectional condition holds.
  1. Construct Con-NF: Extract 961 theorems and 1,348 dependency objects from frontier formal-mathematics projects and align them with natural-language statements.
  1. Retrieve dependencies and generate: Parse library dependencies, construct query–dependency pairs in topological order, retrieve context, generate Lean, and evaluate with BEq@k. Reproduction must fix Lean/Mathlib, automation policies, and retrieval-library versions.

1. 构建等价标注： 收集 200 对多样 Lean 陈述，由专家判断语义是否等价，作为指标测试集。
  1. 运行 BEq： 在两个方向扩展定义并调用受限证明自动化；双向条件满足时判为等价。
  1. 构造 Con-NF： 从前沿数学形式化项目提取 961 个定理及 1,348 个依赖对象，生成或整理对应自然语言。
  1. 依赖检索与生成： 解析库依赖，按拓扑顺序构造 query—dependency 对，检索后生成 Lean 陈述并用 BEq@k 评估。复现需固定 Lean/Mathlib、自动化策略和检索库版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On 200 expert-labelled statement pairs, BEq improves accuracy from 82.50% to 90.50% and precision from 70.59% to 100%. With dependency retrieval, RAutoformalizer raises BEq@8 from 12.83% to 18.18% on ProofNet and from 4.58% to 16.86% on out-of-distribution Con-NF. These controlled results support both the metric and retrieval mechanism, although BEq remains limited by proof automation and cannot discover every true equivalence.

BEq 在 200 对专家标注陈述上把准确率从基线的 82.50% 提高到 90.50%，precision 从 70.59% 提高到 100%。加入依赖检索后，RAutoformalizer 在 ProofNet 的 BEq@8 从 12.83% 升至 18.18%，在分布外 Con-NF 从 4.58% 升至 16.86%。这些受控结果同时支持指标与检索机制，但 BEq 仍可能受自动化证明能力限制，无法证明所有真实等价关系。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Past autoformalization work often treats compilation or string similarity as success and uses theorem libraries as ordinary text corpora. This paper makes semantic equivalence a bidirectional, formally grounded verification contract and defines real formal-library dependencies as a separate retrieval task. Con-NF extends evaluation from competition and textbook statements to research-level objects. The change lies in labels and context sources, not merely more generation samples.
过去自动形式化通常以“能编译”或字符串接近作为成功，检索也多把定理库当普通文本语料。本文的新意是把语义等价变成双向、形式落地的验证契约，并把形式库的真实依赖关系定义为独立检索任务。Con-NF 进一步将评测从竞赛/教材命题扩展到研究级对象。改变的是评测标签与上下文来源，不是简单增加生成采样数。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Incomplete verification: BEq proof failure may reflect weak automation rather than inequivalence, creating false negatives. Unknown outcomes and human adjudication should be retained.
  1. Research-library bias: Con-NF has only 961 theorems from selected formalization projects; it is difficult but domain-limited.
  1. Dependency leakage: Retrieval of the reference or a near-equivalent object can overestimate generation. Reuse must audit candidates, deduplication, and train/test library boundaries.

1. 不完备验证： BEq 证明失败可能只是自动化不足而非不等价，因而仍有假阴性；需报告 unknown 并保留人工仲裁。
  1. 研究库偏置： Con-NF 仅 961 个定理且来自特定形式化项目，难度高但领域覆盖有限。
  1. 依赖泄漏： 如果参考答案或近等价对象被检索，结果可能高估生成能力；复用时应审计检索候选、去重与 train/test 库边界。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate autoformalization: Replace compilation-only success with BEq and report equivalent, inequivalent, and unproved outcomes separately.
  1. Train dependency retrieval: Generate statement–dependency pairs from Lean projects and retrieve context before formalization.
  1. Test OOD generalization: Use Con-NF for research-level objects. With a different prover version, replay all references first; without a formal proof environment, BEq cannot transfer directly, though its bidirectional-verification principle can.

1. 评估自动形式化： 用 BEq 取代单纯编译率，并分别报告等价、非等价和未证明。
  1. 训练依赖检索： 从 Lean 项目生成 statement—dependency 对，检索后再做形式化。
  1. 分布外测试： 用 Con-NF 检查研究级对象泛化。若证明器版本不同，应先重放所有参考陈述；若任务没有形式证明环境，BEq 不能直接迁移，只能借鉴双向验证思想。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: The paper improves autoformalization evaluation and context with BEq, dependency retrieval, and the 961-item Con-NF benchmark.
  2. Method takeaway: Bidirectional unfolding and proving, library-dependency parsing, topological synthesis, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  3. Data takeaway: Con-NF involves 1,348 research objects, plus 200 manually labelled equivalence pairs.
  4. Evidence anchor: BEq reaches 100% precision, and Con-NF BEq@8 rises from 4.58% to 16.86%.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits Lean autoformalization, but proof failure must be separated from semantic error.

1. 一句话定位： 论文用 BEq、依赖检索和 961 题 Con-NF 同时改进自动形式化的评测与上下文。
  2. 方法抓手： 双向定义展开与证明、库依赖解析、拓扑数据合成和 retrieval-augmented generation。
  3. 数据抓手： Con-NF 涉及 1,348 个研究级对象，另有 200 对等价性人工标签。
  4. 证据锚点： BEq precision 达 100%，Con-NF BEq@8 从 4.58% 到 16.86%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 Lean autoformalization；必须把证明失败与语义错误分开。
